answer_summary: The seven opened glucopyranoside repeats contribute five atoms each to the surviving covalent loop and three retained stereocentres each, so rs = 35 and sc = 21.
assumptions: Problem input: the beta-cyclodextrin starting-material diagram contains seven glucopyranoside repeats.
Standard periodate chemistry: NaIO4 cleaves the C2-C3 vicinal-diol bond in each repeat.
Standard borohydride chemistry: NaBH4 reduces the resulting carbonyl ends so the former C2 and C3 sites are methylene carbons.
Acetylation with Ac2O/pyridine changes alcohol functionality but neither reconnects C2-C3 nor adds a stereogenic carbon.
Ring size counts all atoms in the surviving covalent cyclic path.
